'''Kōki Uchiyama''' (Japanese: '''内山昂輝''' ''Uchiyama Kōki'') is a Japanese voice actor for {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
Uchiyama was born on August 16, 1990, in {{wp|Saitama, Saitama}}, {{wp|Japan}}. He became a voice actor as an adult and was commonly cast as male lead characters in anime series. Uchiyama provided the voice of {{un|Cameron}}, one of {{Ash}}'s [[rival]]s in the [[Unova]] [[region]], during {{aniseries|BW}}. He is currently affiliated with Gekidan Himawari.
